2) Technical review with Marissa to cover KMS/audit log questions (30–45 min).
3) If that looks good, we can draft an initial mutual action plan and timeline for a pilot.

Are you available early next week for a short call? I can share calendar options — propose Mon/Tue mornings PST. If it's easier, I'm happy to walk Sophie or anyone else on your team through the deck.
